sources.english: You have a right to perform your prescribed duty, but you are not entitled to the fruits of action.
sources.hindi: कर्म ही तुम्हारा अधिकार है, फल का नहीं।

sources.sanskrit: योगस्थः कुरु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा धनञ्जय।
sources.english: Perform your duty with equanimity, abandoning attachment to success and failure.
sources.hindi: समत्व में स्थित होकर कर्म करो, आसक्ति को त्याग दो।
